title: Discovery Trace Graph Schema
description: A digest-bound trace graph (SW-159-BP-TRACE-001) emitted when Blueprint ingests applicable discovery Markdown. It records, for every used discovery statement, the source path it was read from, the sha256 of that source document, the heading it appeared under, its stable problem ID and the sha256 of the statement body; a versioned TraceLink from each problem to an epic, a task, or a named deferral; the grounding digests captured at ingestion; and any conflicting discovery statements as unresolved conflicts. Unknown keys are rejected at every level and a recomputed digest is required, so a dropped mandatory problem, a missing link, a silently dropped conflict, or any post-hoc edit to a digested field fails closed rather than passing.

schema_version.description: Trace graph schema version. Only v1 exists.

trace_link_version.description: Version of the TraceLink contract carried by this graph. A consumer refuses any value it does not know rather than misreading the link shape.

grounding.description: The source documents captured at grounding time, one entry per path, ordered by path. Each digest is recomputed by verify_grounding so post-grounding drift fails closed.

sha256.description: Canonical lowercase sha256 of the whole source document as read at grounding time.

sources.description: Ordered used-statement records. Order is significant and digested. At least one used statement is required: a graph that ingests nothing is meaningless.

path.description: Source document path the statement was read from.

sha256.description: Digest of the whole source document; must match the matching grounding entry.

heading.description: The heading the statement appeared under.

problem_id.description: Stable problem ID (PREFIX-NNN) the statement asserts.

statement_sha256.description: Canonical lowercase sha256 of the exact statement body text.

links.description: Versioned TraceLink records, at most one per problem. Every recorded problem must have exactly one link.

disposition.description: epic/task = the problem is realised by that target; deferred = the problem is carried by a named deferral.

target.description: The epic or task identifier a non-deferred problem resolves to.

deferral.description: A named deferral: who owns it, why, against which version and target. An unnamed deferral is refused.

conflicts.description: Conflicting discovery statements surfaced as unresolved conflicts. A contradiction that is not surfaced here is refused, and an unresolved conflict blocks grounding.

sources.description: The at-least-two source paths that contradict each other for this problem.

resolved.description: Conflicts are surfaced unresolved; a claim of resolution without a recorded resolution is refused.

mandatory_problems.description: Problems declared mandatory: each must appear among the used statements and be linked, or the graph fails closed as a silent loss.

digest.description: Canonical lowercase sha256 over the graph with this field excluded; recomputed and compared on ingestion so any post-hoc mutation of a digested field fails closed.
